target.title: fix(commands): widen isLocalBaseUrl to full 127.0.0.0/8 loopback range
target.body:
## What

Changed `isLocalBaseUrl` in the model status command from exact `"127.0.0.1"` match to `host.startsWith("127.")`, covering the full 127.0.0.0/8 loopback range.

## Why

The `openclaw status` command uses `isLocalBaseUrl` to classify model provider URLs as local or remote. A model service running on `127.0.0.2:11434` would not be recognized as local. This is a display/UX fix — classification for status output.

Note: `0.0.0.0` (INADDR_ANY) and `::` (IPv6 unspecified) are intentionally preserved as local for status display purposes, consistent with the existing contract.

## Evidence

- Affected file: `src/commands/models/list.local-url.ts`
- The canonical `isLoopbackIpAddress` in `packages/net-policy/src/ip.ts` covers the full 127/8 range
- `0.0.0.0` and `::` are preserved as intentional wildcard-bind display classifiers
